nodes.label: Junet.store V1 Foundation
nodes.rationale: Establishes a bilingual, mobile-first knowledge site with stable route identities and repository-governed content.

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph v0.3.0 Publication Flow
nodes.rationale: Makes discovery, installation, trust boundaries, and contribution guidance part of the initial public knowledge surface.

nodes.label: Security and Supply-Chain Hardening
nodes.rationale: Combines strict content validation, security headers, local assets, CI, CodeQL, dependency review, Dependabot, and patched production dependency overrides.

nodes.label: HSTS Deferral
nodes.rationale: Defers irreversible transport policy until apex and www TLS and canonical redirect behavior are proven at production cutover.

nodes.label: Feature 001 Junet Store Foundation
nodes.rationale: Defines the implemented local checkpoint while explicitly withholding production authorization.

nodes.label: Release Candidate Gate
nodes.rationale: Requires dependency installation, project checks, production audit, Graphify and GitNexus refresh, browser matrices, Lighthouse, a clean diff, and private preview evidence before release.

nodes.label: Production Approval Blockers
nodes.rationale: Prevents production deployment until private preview approval, DNS rollback evidence, TLS and redirects, and protected-main checks exist.

nodes.label: Previous Known-Good Version Rollback
nodes.rationale: Restores the last known-good Sites version and backed-up edge configuration while preserving journal history through appended corrections.

nodes.label: Junet.store Knowledge Hub
nodes.rationale: Defines the project as a bilingual, mobile-first hub for practical AI, MQL5, sustainable vibe coding, and open source.

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph Flagship Project
nodes.rationale: Positions MQL5 CodeGraph as the hub's flagship community project and links to its GitHub repository.

nodes.label: Repository-Owned Bilingual Markdown
nodes.rationale: Avoids CMS and runtime data services by requiring paired Vietnamese and English Markdown files for every published article.

nodes.label: Spec, Architecture, Runbook, and Journal Governance
nodes.rationale: Routes feature history, architecture decisions, operations, append-only evidence, and release handoff into explicit repository locations.
nodes.norm_label: spec, architecture, runbook, and journal governance

nodes.label: MetaQuotes Independence Notice
nodes.rationale: Clarifies trademark ownership and disclaims affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship by MetaQuotes Ltd.

nodes.label: Private Vulnerability Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Keeps vulnerability details, credentials, private source, personal data, and attack traffic out of public issues.

nodes.label: Minimal V1 Attack Surface
nodes.rationale: V1 omits accounts, forms, uploads, databases, analytics, and public application APIs.

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph Advisory Boundary
nodes.rationale: Routes MQL5 CodeGraph vulnerabilities to that separate project's private advisory flow.

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph Static Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Maps MQL5 declarations, includes, calls, and MetaTrader runtime relationships with type, direction, origin, and source location.

nodes.label: Intelligence Kernel Shared Semantics
nodes.rationale: Lets CLI, local dashboard, and MCP adapter project the same query, context, impact, and directed-path semantics for cross-checking.

nodes.label: Static Analysis Evidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: A tolerant tokenizer and graph can orient analysis but cannot prove execution, compilation, safety, strategic correctness, or profitability; diagnostics remain evidence.

nodes.label: Snapshot Tĩnh MQL5 CodeGraph
nodes.rationale: Lập bản đồ declaration, include, lời gọi và quan hệ runtime MetaTrader cùng loại, hướng, nguồn và vị trí.

nodes.label: Ngữ Nghĩa Chung Của Intelligence Kernel
nodes.rationale: CLI, dashboard local và MCP cùng trình bày query, context, impact và đường đi có hướng từ một snapshot chuẩn.
nodes.norm_label: ngu nghia chung cua intelligence kernel

nodes.label: Ranh Giới Bằng Chứng Phân Tích Tĩnh
nodes.rationale: Đồ thị hỗ trợ định hướng nhưng không chứng minh thực thi, compile, an toàn, đúng chiến lược hoặc lợi nhuận; diagnostics là một phần bằng chứng.
nodes.norm_label: ranh gioi bang chung phan tich tinh

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph v0.3.0 Public Beta Installation
nodes.rationale: Installs the Python 3.11+ public wheel and verifies both CLI and stdio MCP entry points without requiring a cloud account or model API key.
nodes.norm_label: mql5 codegraph v0.3.0 public beta installation

nodes.label: Bounded Trusted Snapshot Workflow
nodes.rationale: Analyzes a separately selected trusted MQL5 repository with a bounded max-work budget, then checks status, query results, context, diagnostics, and evidence origin.

nodes.label: Compiler and Runtime Release Evidence
nodes.rationale: Requires fresh snapshots plus MetaEditor compilation, tests, and backtests because static graphs cannot establish build or runtime truth.

nodes.label: Cài Đặt Public Beta MQL5 CodeGraph v0.3.0
nodes.rationale: Cài wheel public cho Python 3.11+ và xác minh CLI cùng entry point MCP stdio mà không cần cloud hay model API key.
nodes.norm_label: cai đat public beta mql5 codegraph v0.3.0

nodes.label: Quy Trình Snapshot Tin Cậy Có Giới Hạn
nodes.rationale: Phân tích một repository MQL5 riêng được tin cậy với max-work, rồi đọc status, query, context, diagnostics và evidence origin.
nodes.norm_label: quy trinh snapshot tin cay co gioi han

nodes.label: Bằng Chứng Compile Và Runtime Cho Phát Hành
nodes.rationale: Cần snapshot mới, MetaEditor, test và backtest vì static graph không chứng minh build hay runtime truth.
nodes.norm_label: bang chung compile va runtime cho phat hanh

nodes.label: Local MCP Registration Boundary
nodes.rationale: Each client must have local terminal, filesystem, installation permission, Python 3.11+, and its own stdio MCP registration; a GitHub URL is not installation.

nodes.label: RAM-Only MCP Snapshot Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: A process restart or closed transport discards the in-memory snapshot, requiring a fresh task, project_status check, and re-index of the operator-selected project.

nodes.label: Reference Corpus and Read-Only Tool Boundary
nodes.rationale: Separates operator-owned cited PDF corpora and optional Graphify discovery from the plugin's read-only MCP surface, while acknowledging unrelated shell tools may still mutate files.
nodes.norm_label: reference corpus and read-only tool boundary

nodes.label: Ranh Giới Đăng Ký MCP Local
nodes.rationale: Mỗi client cần terminal, filesystem, quyền cài đặt, Python 3.11+ và cấu hình MCP stdio riêng; URL GitHub không phải cài đặt.
nodes.norm_label: ranh gioi đang ky mcp local

nodes.label: Vòng Đời Snapshot MCP Trong RAM
nodes.rationale: Process restart hoặc Transport closed làm mất snapshot, nên phải mở task mới, kiểm tra project_status và index lại project được chọn.
nodes.norm_label: vong đoi snapshot mcp trong ram

nodes.label: Ranh Giới Corpus Tham Chiếu Và Tool Read-Only
nodes.rationale: Tách PDF có page citation và Graphify discovery khỏi bề mặt MCP read-only, đồng thời thừa nhận shell hoặc editor khác vẫn có thể sửa file.
nodes.norm_label: ranh gioi corpus tham chieu va tool read-only

nodes.label: Behavior-Scoped Bounded Review
nodes.rationale: Starts from one entry point and testable behavior, then gathers callers, callees, includes, and bounded context while preserving symbol ambiguity.

nodes.label: Impact Graph and Smallest Causal Change
nodes.rationale: Uses upstream callers, downstream dependencies, and directed paths as a review list before making one root-cause fix and refreshing the snapshot.
nodes.norm_label: impact graph and smallest causal change

nodes.label: Layered Static, Compiler, and Runtime Evidence
nodes.rationale: Keeps structural analyzer claims separate from MetaEditor compile logs, backtests, forward tests, and terminal logs.
nodes.norm_label: layered static, compiler, and runtime evidence

nodes.label: Review Theo Hành Vi Với Context Có Giới Hạn
nodes.rationale: Bắt đầu từ một entry point và hành vi kiểm chứng được, rồi thu thập caller, callee, include và context có ngân sách mà vẫn giữ ambiguity.
nodes.norm_label: review theo hanh vi voi context co gioi han

nodes.label: Impact Graph Và Thay Đổi Nhân Quả Nhỏ Nhất
nodes.rationale: Dùng upstream caller, downstream dependency và directed path làm danh sách review trước khi sửa một nguyên nhân gốc và tạo snapshot mới.
nodes.norm_label: impact graph va thay đoi nhan qua nho nhat

nodes.label: Mô Hình Bằng Chứng Static, Compiler Và Runtime
nodes.rationale: Tách claim của static analyzer khỏi MetaEditor log, backtest, forward test và terminal log.
nodes.norm_label: mo hinh bang chung static, compiler va runtime

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Bounded Change
nodes.rationale: Captures audience, success, scope, evidence, ADR trade-offs, touched files, preserved contracts, and tests before code or abstraction growth.

nodes.label: Graph-Assisted Layered Proof
nodes.rationale: Uses CodeGraph, GitNexus, and Graphify as maps, then relies on lint, types, tests, builds, compiler/runtime evidence, and browser or HTTP probes as terrain.

nodes.label: Append-Only Open-Source Governance
nodes.rationale: Preserves project memory with append-only milestone evidence and responsible README, license, contribution, security, acknowledgement, and measured-claim practices.

nodes.label: Thay Đổi Có Biên Theo Spec
nodes.rationale: Ghi đối tượng, thành công, phạm vi, bằng chứng, trade-off ADR, file chạm, contract giữ và test trước khi code hoặc thêm abstraction.
nodes.norm_label: thay đoi co bien theo spec

nodes.label: Chứng Minh Nhiều Lớp Có Graph Hỗ Trợ
nodes.rationale: Dùng CodeGraph, GitNexus và Graphify làm bản đồ, rồi kiểm chứng bằng lint, typecheck, test, build, compiler/runtime và browser hoặc HTTP probe.
nodes.norm_label: chung minh nhieu lop co graph ho tro

nodes.label: Quản Trị Mã Nguồn Mở Nối Đuôi
nodes.rationale: Giữ trí nhớ dự án bằng milestone và correction nối đuôi cùng README, license, hướng dẫn đóng góp, security channel, cảm ơn và claim có số đo.
nodes.norm_label: quan tri ma nguon mo noi đuoi

nodes.label: Strict Markdown Content Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Transforms paired locale files through strict YAML parsing, Zod, parity, slug, and safety validation before publication.

nodes.label: Stable Article Identity Registry
nodes.rationale: Maps immutable id and translationId values to idiomatic localized slugs so language switching never rewrites URL text.

nodes.label: Safe Markdown Rendering
nodes.rationale: Uses explicit Vite raw imports, module-load parsing, React Markdown and GFM without rehype-raw, runtime scans, or CMS calls.

nodes.label: Bilingual Content Contract
nodes.rationale: Rejects incomplete locale pairs, duplicate localized slugs, raw HTML, inline handlers, and JavaScript URLs before publishing.

nodes.label: Protected Main Release Candidate
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions validates a protected-main commit without holding deployment credentials, making that exact commit the release candidate.

nodes.label: Private Sites Approval Gate
nodes.rationale: Codex and Sites package the clean candidate into a saved private preview; production waits for explicit maintainer review and approval.

nodes.label: Cloudflare and Sites Public Path
nodes.rationale: Places Cloudflare DNS and edge protection before Sites, with immutable hashed assets and private non-cacheable locale redirects.

nodes.label: HSTS Cutover Guard
nodes.rationale: Avoids premature irreversible lockout by waiting for valid apex and www TLS plus proven redirect behavior.

nodes.label: Known-Good Sites Rollback
nodes.rationale: Redeploys the previous version and restores exported DNS records and edge rules after a failed cutover.

nodes.label: Private Locale Negotiation
nodes.rationale: Returns a non-cacheable 307 from the root using Accept-Language with Vietnamese as deterministic fallback.

nodes.label: Localized URL and Hreflang Metadata
nodes.rationale: Assigns explicit Vietnamese and English paths, canonicals, hreflang entries, and Vietnamese x-default to every public identity.

nodes.label: Pre-Hydration Theme Initialization
nodes.rationale: Reads only light or dark from localStorage, otherwise follows system preference, and sets theme and color scheme before first content paint.

nodes.label: Accessible Mobile Interactions
nodes.rationale: Avoids hover dependence, provides 44-pixel controls, safe-area layouts, independent code scrolling, body-scroll locking, and reduced-motion behavior.

nodes.label: Read-Only Content Application
nodes.rationale: Eliminates application origin, API, accounts, forms, CMS, database, analytics, and remote content dependencies.

nodes.label: Vinext Worker-Compatible Sites Artifact
nodes.rationale: Compiles the site into a Cloudflare Worker-compatible artifact that negotiates locale, renders routes, and serves bundled assets.

nodes.label: Typed Route and Content Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Separates HTTP entry points, UI surfaces, route identities and content contracts, Markdown content, local assets, and packaging integration into named directories.

nodes.label: Validation-to-Private-Release Flow
nodes.rationale: Moves GitHub CI validation through a private Sites version and explicit approval before the edge receives production traffic.

nodes.label: Graphify and GitNexus Evidence Lanes
nodes.rationale: Uses Graphify as durable code-doc architecture evidence and GitNexus as a local, uncommitted symbol and impact index.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Repository Governance
nodes.rationale: Requires material work to begin with a feature spec and routes architecture, ADR, runbook, and append-only journal duties into docs.

nodes.label: Content, UI, and Runtime Release Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Assigns routing impact review, UI accessibility QA, bilingual content checks, and external-fact revalidation to their owning paths.
nodes.norm_label: content, ui, and runtime release boundaries

nodes.label: Reviewed Public Graph Outputs
nodes.rationale: Allows only graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.html from graphify-out to be committed.

nodes.label: Excluded Generated and Sensitive Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Keeps build output, credentials, tokens, caches, traces, browser evidence, and local intelligence indexes out of version control.

nodes.label: Minimized Static Attack Surface
nodes.rationale: Serving read-only content without auth, forms, uploads, user-controlled rendering, databases, APIs, analytics, ads, or third-party scripts reduces exposed behavior.

nodes.label: Default-Deny Browser Security Policy
nodes.rationale: Applies CSP, anti-framing, MIME sniffing protection, restrictive referrer and permission policies, same-origin isolation, and no framework disclosure.

nodes.label: Vinext Inline Compatibility Exception
nodes.rationale: Permits narrowly scoped inline script and style compatibility required by Vinext and RSC while forbidding unsafe-eval and third-party origins; the local parser-blocking theme script is intentional.

nodes.label: Cloudflare DDoS and Managed Rules
nodes.rationale: Uses baseline DDoS protection and observed managed-rule behavior without permanently challenging ordinary static GET traffic.

nodes.label: Measured Narrow Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Introduces at most one reviewed high-threshold or narrow-path rule only after measured abuse, excludes verified bots, starts with Managed Challenge, and journals false positives.

nodes.label: Stable Localized Route Identity
nodes.rationale: Uses explicit stable route and article IDs behind separate vi and en route families so idiomatic slugs do not depend on fragile string replacement.

nodes.label: Private Non-Cacheable Root Negotiation
nodes.rationale: Uses a private 307 with Vietnamese fallback to keep the initial locale decision deterministic and visitor-specific.

nodes.label: Bilingual Canonical and Hreflang Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires both localized paths and complete canonical and hreflang metadata for every new public identity.

nodes.label: System-first Persisted Theme
nodes.rationale: Use a valid stored light or dark choice first, then the device preference, so first paint is correct without cookies or server state.

nodes.label: Repository-owned Markdown
nodes.rationale: Treat content changes like code so reviews, version history, and deterministic build-time validation govern publication.

nodes.label: Sites-controlled Delivery
nodes.rationale: Keep validation in GitHub while publishing an exact saved Sites version through an explicit human approval gate, avoiding long-lived deployment credentials.

nodes.label: Static-first Edge Security
nodes.rationale: Minimize the V1 attack surface while preserving crawler access and escalating controls only from observed abuse.

nodes.label: Progressive DDoS Response
nodes.rationale: Distinguish hostile traffic from release defects or crawler spikes, improve cache first, then escalate narrowly and reversibly.

nodes.label: Conservative HSTS Activation
nodes.rationale: Enable HSTS only after apex and www TLS and redirects remain correct through an observation window; do not preload in V1.

nodes.label: Graphify Confidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: Preserve EXTRACTED, INFERRED, and AMBIGUOUS meanings instead of promoting uncertainty merely to satisfy health checks.

nodes.label: Append-only Release Record
nodes.rationale: Corrections are dated follow-ups so release provenance and earlier evidence cannot be silently rewritten.

nodes.label: Content-only Vinext Application
nodes.rationale: The content-only Worker-compatible architecture provides the required bilingual public site without adding databases, accounts, analytics, forms, or remote content dependencies.

nodes.label: Worker and Browser Release Quality Gate
nodes.norm_label: worker and browser release quality gate

nodes.label: Preserve Sites Vinext Runtime
nodes.rationale: The generated Vinext/Vite/Worker structure is the supported Sites packaging path and already emits Worker-compatible ESM; replacing it adds migration risk.

nodes.label: Stable Localized Route Identity
nodes.rationale: Stable identities preserve equivalent language switching when localized paths and slugs differ; path replacement is unsafe.

nodes.label: Build-time Strict Markdown
nodes.rationale: Explicit raw imports plus strict parsing avoid runtime filesystem access, executable MDX, and remote-CMS availability and privacy costs.

nodes.label: System-first No-flash Theme
nodes.rationale: A checked-in blocking initializer avoids wrong-theme flash without third-party packages, cookies, or server cache variation.

nodes.label: RSC-compatible Content Security Policy
nodes.rationale: Use the minimum verified inline concession because a nonce-only policy may break current pre-1.0 RSC hydration; never allow unsafe-eval or third-party origins.

nodes.label: Validation-only CI and Controlled CD
nodes.rationale: Current Sites publication is connector-driven, so CI validates a pinned SHA while an operator approves publication without reusable deployment credentials.

nodes.label: Distinct Graphify and GitNexus Evidence Roles
nodes.rationale: Graphify provides durable reviewed architecture evidence while GitNexus remains a local change-impact index; neither is runtime truth.
nodes.norm_label: distinct graphify and gitnexus evidence roles

nodes.label: Factual MQL5 CodeGraph Boundary
nodes.rationale: Publish only verified release, license, platform, local-processing, experimental-tooling, and RAM-state facts while rejecting unsupported safety or capability claims.

nodes.label: MQL5 CodeGraph Flagship Journey
nodes.rationale: Promoting the flagship open-source repository is the primary V1 purpose.

nodes.label: Bilingual Knowledge Journey
nodes.rationale: Complete equivalent Vietnamese and English content makes the site a durable knowledge hub rather than a single campaign page.

nodes.label: Responsive Accessible Journey
nodes.rationale: Mobile compatibility, accessibility, and visual identity are product requirements, including touch targets, keyboard access, and no layout overflow.

nodes.label: Community Continuity Journey
nodes.rationale: Community participation and verified contribution paths create long-term value beyond the flagship launch.

nodes.label: Trustworthy Release Journey
nodes.rationale: The public domain must bind exact evidence and explicit approval to deployment and preserve a known-good rollback path.

nodes.label: Private Deployment and Production Cutover Tasks
nodes.norm_label: private deployment and production cutover tasks

nodes.label: AI x MQL5 x Open Source Positioning
nodes.norm_label: ai x mql5 x open source positioning

nodes.label: Navy Cyan and Amber Visual System
nodes.rationale: The dark navy field establishes a technical backdrop, cyan carries the brand and graph structure, and amber isolates a traversed path or important graph nodes.
nodes.norm_label: navy cyan and amber visual system

nodes.label: Junet.store Social Preview Branding
nodes.rationale: The wide promotional composition is designed to identify Junet.store and communicate its AI, MQL5, and open-source focus in link previews and social sharing surfaces.
